endpoint.ask: WCF endpoint of the Bluehill Universal API on this PC
endpoint.help: From the API help installed with Bluehill (Start > Instron > Help > Bluehill Help > API). The shipped value is a placeholder.

outputs_dir.ask: Folder the Bluehill method exports results to
outputs_dir.help: The method's Export tab: results table (file 1) and raw data (file 2), CSV, file name from the sample name, written at finish.

methods_dir.ask: Folder holding the Bluehill methods an agent may run

results_suffix.ask: Suffix the results export adds to the sample name

raw_suffix.ask: Suffix the raw-data export adds to the sample name (blank if none)

max_test_minutes.ask: Longest test an agent may run (minutes)
